author: Kushal
problem: tent and pitch are (length, width) sizes in metres. Return whether the tent can be put up on the pitch, turned either way, without going over the pitch's edges.
bug_description: Compares sides with t < p instead of t <= p, so a tent whose side exactly matches the pitch is said not to fit.

comments.accurate: True if the tent fits on the pitch in either orientation
comments.wrong_behavior: True if the tent fits on the pitch in either orientation with room to spare on every side
comments.wrong_location: Side comparison checked; sorting the sizes may pair the wrong sides together
